title: Jazz It Up
style: Ultra-quiet off-kilter jazz built around a drip-click-hum motif that starts staggered, then settles into a soft swing pocket. Foreground walking upright bass or lyrical fretless bass leads over warm Rhodes comping, sparse piano voicings, brushed snare, and hushed ride cymbal. Close-mic breathy vocals, tape saturation, soft room reverb, and subtle horn counterlines throughout.
lyrics:

It's not a zip-zop-zoop-zoop
It's not a rip-rip-rap-rap

It's a drip-click-hum
That's the way it's done
Foreground walking upright
Jazz it up
